title: Nemotron LoRA SFT v1 Trained Adapter
subtitle: Trained LoRA adapter from kernel gideonnazarian/nemotron-lora-sft-v1
description: LoRA adapter weights from the first SFT training run on 750 stratified solver-generated examples. Base model: metric/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b-bf16. Public leaderboard score: 0.51 (vs untrained baseline 0.50). Saved here so downstream eval kernels can load the adapter without re-training.
